tools.name: search_iptv
tools.description: Search and rank IPTV and live-TV services by price, devices, resolution, trial, payment and country, and look for channels in their lineups. Returns providers (cheapest first; our own service is pinned and flagged featured) and any matching channels.

tools.name: search_channels
tools.description: Find a channel by name across indexed IPTV lineups. Returns channel, category, country, quality and which provider carries it.

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: Everything known about one provider: plans, prices, devices, apps, trial, payment and (when indexed) its lineup by country.

tools.name: compare_providers
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of two to five providers by slug.

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Open a checkout for an ArgonTV subscription, which this site resells. Returns a pay_url where the person pays with any supported coin or PayPal, and an order_url where their login appears once paid. Ask for their email first; the login is sent there.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: Every provider in the register, cheapest first, with slug, kind and per-month price.

tools.name: search_seedboxes
tools.description: Search and rank seedbox providers by price, storage, port speed, unmetered traffic, apps (Plex, qBittorrent, rTorrent, the *arrs), datacenter country, type and payment. Returns providers cheapest first with the best matching plan; nothing is pinned, this site sells no seedbox.

tools.name: get_seedbox
tools.description: Everything known about one seedbox provider: every plan with price, storage, port, traffic and location, plus apps, features, payment, refund and trial.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_checkout · Public sink: start_checkout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_checkout · Public sink: start_checkout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
